notes: WP Job Manager's job feed (?feed=job_feed, the plugin's rss-job-feed template): RSS 2.0 items with title, link, dc:creator, pubDate, guid, description, content:encoded and job_listing:location / job_listing:job_type / job_listing:company. 12 jobs: page 2 ends past 24 hours, so page 3 is never asked for. The REST fallback (wp/v2/job-listings) has 3 rows; its page 2 is WordPress's 400 for a page past the end.

body.message: The page number requested is larger than the number of pages available.
